acceptanceNote: Accepted artifacts and recorded evaluations. Publication is not independent verification of research claims.
objective:
Characterize the holder base of the identity.md NFT collection on Ethereum
mainnet: 0x0000ec93127baa929e58e97dd0095a2bfb38ec1d

Take the top 500 holders by balance. Aggregate statistics only.

Answer one question: what kind of people hold this, judged purely by their
on-chain behaviour.

Measure:
- how long they have held their identity.md, median and distribution. What share
  still holds every token they received at mint
- their track record on everything else: median age of the other ERC-20 and NFT
  positions currently sitting in those wallets
- flip rate: share of these wallets that bought and sold any NFT within 30 days,
  over the last year
- wallet age: when each address first transacted on Ethereum, distribution
- how many are dormant, no outgoing transaction in 90 days

Exclude contracts, burn addresses and exchange wallets. Say which you excluded
and how you found them. Report the block height for every number.

Then write three posts for X, one per finding, and let me pick.

Voice rules, follow exactly:
- lowercase throughout, capitalize only "I" and tickers like $IMD
- two to four short lines, blank line between each, never paragraphs or bullets
- no em dashes, no emojis, no hashtags, no call to action
- exactly ONE number per post, stated flat, no adjectives, no hype
- end on a question to the reader

Under each post, list the number used and where it came from.

Do not identify anyone. No addresses, no ens names, no social accounts, no
individual profiles, no net worth estimates.
